title: Verticalized Financial Services Enablement Playbook & Demo Scripts
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Context: We're preparing a verticalized enablement kit for Financial Services customers to accompany the Private deployment privacy and KMS improvements in private-2026.03. The goal is to give Sales and CS concise, compliant narratives and friction-free demo scripts that surface RBAC, tenant isolation, KMS integration, and audit logging without getting bogged down in infra detail. Deliverables: 1) One-page battlecard tailored to FinServ buyer personas (CISO, Head of ML, Platform Eng). 2) 2x sales one-pagers (GTM and technical) highlighting risk reduction, audit trails, and short TCO points. 3) Objection map with phrasing for data residency, encryption, and upgrade windows. 4) Three live demo scripts (intro call, security deep-dive, POC run-through) with step-by-step actions and expected console screenshots. 5) Two recorded walkthroughs (10m security overview, 12m POC run). 6) FinServ-specific FAQ and checklist for CS precall readiness. Scope exclusions: deep lab-run performance benchmarks (kept in engineering docs), and new legal contract templates (handled by Legal).
